verdict.rationale: Alacritty documents an IPC interface via `alacritty msg`, enabled by a config option, and the `alacritty msg create-window` subcommand opens new windows from the command line, so the window-opening part of the story is covered first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows sending text to a terminal or querying terminal or window state through this interface, which is roughly half the story. Missing for 10: send-text capability, state query capability, depth of the IPC command set, independent corroboration.
